rationale: Independent reading: EO 11841 (40 FR 8933) has one operative act, adding sec. 306 (Development Coordination Committee) to EO 10973 'as amended'. Held EO 12163 (44 FR 56673) sec. 1-903(a)(1) revokes 'Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended' and sec. 1-506 establishes a new Development Coordination Committee. EO 11841 is not named, but its only content was inserted into EO 10973 and is revoked with it 'as amended'; 1-904 saves delegations, regulations and other actions not the inserted provision. Same pure-amendment reasoning as accepted for EO 13137 in y1_01. I agree: NO (by the parent-revoked-as-amended inference, stated as such).
